_comment: Field filter for dataforseo-mcp-server 3.x, loaded via FIELD_CONFIG_PATH. v3 keys the config by API endpoint path, e.g. "/v3/serp/google/organic/live/advanced": ["id", "items.title", "items.url", "status_code"]. The v2 module-keyed format is rejected by v3 and then ignored. Empty on purpose: v3 already returns the trimmed .ai response by default, and its built-in Lighthouse filter still applies. An empty list [] for a path returns the full response. Format: https://github.com/dataforseo/mcp-server-typescript#field-configuration
